segments.zh: 你经常完成它吗？

segments.en: I didn't used to, but I really enjoy them now.
segments.zh: 我不习惯，但我现在真的很喜欢它们。

segments.en: I think it's a nice way to relax on the weekends.
segments.zh: 我认为这是周末放松的好方法。

segments.en: So every couple of weeks, I go to the nail salon and I get my nails done.
segments.zh: 所以每隔几周，我就会去美甲沙龙，把我的指甲做好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I think one of the words that we didn't talk about here, but it's very, I don't know, for men it's kind of a strange smell, is nail polish remover.
segments.zh: 我认为我们在这里没有谈论的一个词之一，但我不知道，对于男人来说，这是一种奇怪的气味，是指甲油去除剂。

segments.en: The acetone, right?
segments.zh: 丙酮对吧？

segments.en: It's a very strong chemical.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常强的化学物质。

segments.en: It is really disgusting.
segments.zh: 这真的很恶心。

segments.en: Nail polish remover, you know, the word to remove means to take away.
segments.zh: 指甲油去除剂，你知道的，去除的词意味着带走。

segments.en: And so when the nail polish, we want to change the color, we have to use this.
segments.zh: 所以当指甲油时，我们要改变颜色，我们必须使用它。

segments.en: It's like water, but it smells really bad.
segments.zh: 它就像水，但它闻起来很糟糕。

segments.en: And so my boyfriend always gets angry when I use the nail polish remover because the whole house starts to stink.
segments.zh: 所以当我使用指甲油去除剂时，我的男朋友总是很生气，因为整个房子都开始发臭了。

segments.en: It's a very strong smell and you get kind of dizzy.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常强烈的气味，你会感到头晕目眩。

segments.en: So that's why.
segments.zh: 原来是这个原因。

segments.en: Yeah, it goes into your head.
segments.zh: 是的，它进入你的脑海。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.zh: 大家再见。
